title: Eight languages
text: TypeScript, JavaScript, JSON, HTML, CSS, SQL, Bash, and Markdown, highlighted by an in-repo tokenizer that only creates text nodes.

title: Diff built in
text: Unified or side-by-side views from a Myers line diff, with Added and Removed spoken, not just colored.

title: 10,000 lines
text: Large files are virtualized; only the rows in view are in the DOM, and wrapped rows are measured as they render.

title: Copy and wrap
text: One-click copy with an announced result, a wrap toggle, highlighted lines, and pinned line numbers.

title: Themed tokens
text: Every token color is a theme token that passes the contrast gate on code, added, removed, and highlighted lines.
